title: Substitute idempotent-no-op returns 200 substituted:true when the slot's live occupant is a SKIPPED row with the same snapshot — no invitation will go out
detail: Walk: objected row -> substitute (successor queued) -> landlord skips the successor -> re-substitute the OLD terminal row with the same trio. insert_reference_call_if_absent conflicts (skipped occupies the live slot — skipped is NOT in is_terminal, trigger.gleam:1153), find_live_row_for_slot returns the skipped row, trio_matches_row matches its snapshot -> Ok(Existing) -> 200 with no audit and no queued row; the client toasts "Referee substituted - the new invitation is on its way", which is false. The r2 W7 Existing design assumed a queued successor (double-submit); a skipped occupant silently mis-answers.
recommended_fix: In the Existing arm, distinguish a skipped successor (status == 'skipped' -> 409 AlreadyReplaced, or return the successor's status so the client can surface it) from a queued one (true idempotent no-op).
